nodes.label: Checklists Section (Чек-листы)
nodes.rationale: Named checklists (Утренний ритуал 3/5, Тренировка 2/4, Вечерний ритуал 0/4) each rendered with icon, horizontal progress bar, completion count, and chevron to expand. Progress bar colors (blue/teal/purple) echo the ring colors of the corresponding domains.

nodes.label: Goals Section (Цели)
nodes.rationale: Checklist-style goal list with square checkboxes (e.g. 'Прочитать 20 страниц книги', 'Пить 2 литра воды'). '+ добавить' link in accent blue top-right for quick add. Scrollable card with visible scrollbar indicating more items than fit.

nodes.label: Schedule Section (Расписание)
nodes.rationale: Time-ordered event list with teal timestamps (06:30 Утренний ритуал, 19:30 Тренировка, 21:00 Вечерний ритуал) and '+ событие' quick-add link. Ritual-based framing (morning/evening rituals) reflects the app's discipline-focused philosophy.

nodes.label: Day Progress Triple Ring Combo
nodes.rationale: Design decision: three large circular progress rings side-by-side aggregate the day's completion across three tracking domains - Goals (Цели, 50%, blue), Schedule (Расписание, 33%, teal), Checklists (Чек-листы, 38%, purple). Each ring shows percentage inside and a count fraction (2/4, 1/3, 5/13) plus icon beneath. The three-ring combo gives at-a-glance holistic progress instead of three separate widgets; color coding matches section colors below for visual continuity.

nodes.label: Bottom Navigation (5 tabs)
nodes.rationale: Five-tab bottom navigation: СЕГОДНЯ (Today, active in blue), ЗАПИСИ (Entries), БЛОГ (Blog), ПУТЬ (Path/Journey), СИСТЕМА (System/Settings). Five-tab structure positions Today as the home/default tab.

nodes.label: Notes Section (Заметки)
nodes.rationale: Collapsed notes card showing motivational preview text 'Фокус на дисциплине, а не на мотивации' (focus on discipline, not motivation) - a core product philosophy statement; chevron indicates tap to open full notes.

nodes.label: Today Screen (Сегодня)
nodes.rationale: Main daily dashboard screen of a Russian-language habit/discipline tracking app. Dark navy theme with neon blue/teal/purple accents chosen for a calm, focused nighttime aesthetic. Header shows current date with a notification bell.

nodes.label: Day Checklists Row (Чек-листы дня)
nodes.rationale: Three time-of-day checklist cards (Утро 3/5, Фокус 0/4, Вечер 0/5) each with icon, count chip, item checkboxes, and a per-card progress bar; a dashed '+ Добавить чек-лист' placeholder card sits at the end. Segments routine tasks by day part.

nodes.label: Day Goals Card (Цели дня)
nodes.rationale: Numbered checklist of 4 daily goals with completion checkboxes (first goal done, highlighted green) and a dashed '+ Добавить цель' button. Design decision: goals are capped/ordered as a short numbered list to keep daily focus narrow.

nodes.label: Day Progress Ring (Прогресс дня)
nodes.rationale: Circular progress ring at 62% with motivational microcopy ('Отличная работа! Держи темп 💪'). Gamification element that aggregates the day's completion across goals/checklists into a single glanceable metric, echoed in the sidebar 'СЕГОДНЯ 62%' and the top bar.

nodes.label: Left Navigation Rail
nodes.rationale: Persistent sidebar with avatar, sections: СЕГОДНЯ (62%), КАЛЕНДАРЬ (3 события), ЧЕК-ЛИСТЫ (4/14), ЗАМЕТКИ (7), ДНЕВНИК, БЛОГ, ГРАФ (62%), БАЛАНС (12 450 ₽), ROADMAP (2/7), ПЛАНИРОВАНИЕ. Inline progress/count badges on each item provide at-a-glance status without navigating.

nodes.label: Quick Notes Card (Быстрые заметки)
nodes.rationale: Stack of recent notes with colored type icons (document, idea/lightbulb, thought/check), date stamps (9 сент, 8 сент, 7 сент), truncated previews, and '+ Новая заметка' action. Color-coding distinguishes note categories at a glance.

nodes.label: Schedule Timeline Card (Расписание)
nodes.rationale: Vertical timeline with time markers (06:30, 19:30, 21:00), event titles, subtitles, and duration/count chips (2 ч, 30 мин), plus '+ Добавить событие' dashed action button. Blue node markers on a connecting vertical line.

nodes.label: Top Context Bar
nodes.rationale: Breadcrumb 'ГЛАВНАЯ / СЕГОДНЯ' on the left and compact status cluster on the right (62%, учёба 19:30, 2/4, v3.0) — surfaces next upcoming event, task counts, and app version persistently.

nodes.label: Telegram Dark Theme Dashboard Mockup (вариант-тг-тёмный)
nodes.rationale: Reference UI mockup for the Provodnik personal-planner app in a dark, Telegram-inspired style. Design intent: a dense single-screen 'Today' dashboard that surfaces all daily planning surfaces (goals, schedule, checklists, notes, progress) at once, with a persistent left navigation rail. Dark navy palette with blue accent, rounded cards, and Cyrillic labels target a Russian-speaking audience.
